In contrast, other studies ([GG_1], [GG_2]) report that in postmenopausal women, hyperprolactinemia may suppress hot flashes by inhibiting the augmented gonadotropin secretion normally seen during menopause. Therefore, the effect depends on whether the woman is premenopausal or postmenopausal.
